finalText:
I settled 12 of the 16 open RMAs and closed them. Three stay open and one is under investigation. There were no inbox messages, so I sent no replies.

**Closed (refunded and restocked)**

| RMA | Refund | Method | Stock |
|---|---|---|---|
| 801 | 10,965 | card | 1 P-KEY sellable |
| 802 | 15,900 | card | 1 P-HDP sellable |
| 803 | 27,965 | store credit, added to C-803's balance | 1 P-MON sellable |
| 804 | 27,965 | store credit, added to C-804's balance | 1 P-MON sellable |
| 805 | 5,520 | card | 1 P-HUB sellable |
| 806 | 7,350 | card | 2 P-MOU damaged |
| 810 | 9,900 | card | 1 P-KEY damaged |
| 811 | 4,900 | card | 1 P-MOU sellable |
| 812 | 21,900 | card | 1 P-DOC damaged |
| 813 | 10,965 | card | 1 P-KEY sellable |
| 814 | 31,800 | card | 2 P-HDP sellable |
| 815 | 10,965 | card | 1 P-KEY sellable |

All amounts are in cents.

- **Fees:** 15% on changed-mind returns (801, 803, 804, 813, 815). PU-15's 20% applied to 805, requested 25 June. PU-21 waived the fee on 802 and 814, requested 14 and 17 July. Defective and damaged returns carried no fee.
- **803 and 804:** These shipped 41 days before the request, and neither customer held gold or platinum status on the request date, so they were paid as store credit.
- **815:** The platinum customer got the 45-day window under PU-18, so the refund went to the card.
- **810:** I refunded 12,900 paid less the 3,000 already refunded, so nothing was paid twice.
- **806:** The line paid 7,350 after a discount code, so that is what I refunded.

**Still open**
- **RMA-809:** Only 2 of 3 units have arrived, so I settled those two. The refund was 3,800 to card with no fee under PU-21. I restocked 1 P-CAB as sellable and 1 as damaged.
- **RMA-807 and RMA-816:** The warehouse has received nothing, so I refunded and restocked nothing. The customer on 807 says the parcel reached our warehouse on 23 July, but no receipt is recorded.
- **RMA-808:** The warehouse received a P-CAB instead of the P-MON this return covers. I refunded and restocked nothing and opened investigation INV-1.

The plan assumed the return window was measured from the order date. I followed the policy instead, which measures it from the date the line shipped.
